text: Hello, I'm Georgie.
And I'm Phil.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 欢迎来到《简单英语》节目。
zh_hant: 歡迎來到《簡單英語》節目。

text: Find all the vocabulary and a worksheet to test what you've learned over on our website.
zh: 在我们的网站上找齐所有词汇和一份工作表，来测试你已学到的内容。
zh_hant: 在我們的網站上找齊所有詞彙和一份工作表，來測試你已學到的內容。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Phil.
How are you doing?
I'm doing really well, Georgie.
I must say, your hair is looking fantastic today.
zh: 我得说，你今天头发看起来棒极了。
zh_hant: 我得說，你今天頭髮看起來棒極了。

text: Thank you very much, Phil.
Today we are talking about hair.
Now, I can see your hair,
but for our listeners maybe you can start by describing your hair.
zh: 但对我们的听众来说，也许你可以先描述一下你的头发。
zh_hant: 但對我們的聽眾來說，也許你可以先描述一下你的頭髮。

text: Well, my hair – it's short,
but it's not very short.
I think it's fairly straight.
And then the colour – it's kind of a light brown colour.
zh: 然后是颜色——它是那种浅棕色的。
zh_hant: 然後是顏色——它是那種淺棕色的。

text: The bits that aren't grey, that is!
zh: 那些没变灰的部分，就是说！
zh_hant: 那些沒變灰的部分，就是說！

text: You said your hair used to be ginger .
zh: 你说你的头发以前是姜黄色的。
zh_hant: 你說你的頭髮以前是薑黃色的。

text: Yes, it used to be ginger – bright orange.
zh: 是的，它以前是姜黄色的——亮橙色。
zh_hant: 是的，它以前是薑黃色的——亮橙色。

text: Wow!
Well, my hair is naturally dark brown.
zh: 嗯，我的头发天生是深棕色的。
zh_hant: 嗯，我的頭髮天生是深棕色的。

text: It's quite short and it's wavy ,
zh: 它相当短而且有点卷曲，
zh_hant: 它相當短而且有點捲曲，

text: so sometimes it can be curly ,
zh: 所以有时候它可能是卷的，
zh_hant: 所以有時候它可能是卷的，

text: but mostly it's wavy .
zh: 但大多数时候是波浪形的。
zh_hant: 但大多數時候是波浪形的。

text: OK.
So, you've told us about your hair, Georgie.
zh: 你跟我们说了你的头发，乔治。
zh_hant: 你跟我們說了你的頭髮，喬治。

text: Do you like it?
Yes, I do now.
I actually...
When I was younger,
I didn't really like my hair
zh: 我真的不太喜欢我的头发
zh_hant: 我真的不太喜歡我的頭髮

text: because I wanted it to be straight,
so I used to straighten it – take the curls and the waves out.
zh: 所以我以前常常把它拉直——把卷和波浪去掉。
zh_hant: 所以我以前常常把它拉直——把卷和波浪去掉。

text: But as I've got older, I've started to really like my hair.
zh: 但随着我长大，我开始真的很喜欢我的头发了。
zh_hant: 但隨著我長大，我開始真的很喜歡我的頭髮了。

text: It looks a bit wild and I enjoy it.
zh: 它看起来有点野性，我挺享受的。
zh_hant: 它看起來有點野性，我挺享受的。

text: What about you?
How do you...
Do you like your hair?
Yeah, usually I do.
I think similar to you.
When I was a teenager, I just wanted my hair to look different,
zh: 我十几岁的时候，就只想让头发看起来不一样，
zh_hant: 我十幾歲的時候，就只想讓頭髮看起來不一樣，

text: so I used to try and stick hair gel in it and try and make it do things
zh: 所以我常常试着抹发胶，试着让它做出一些动作，
zh_hant: 所以我常常試著抹髮膠，試著讓它做出一些動作，

text: that it didn't want to do and it wasn't going to do.
And I used to get very frustrated about that.
zh: 而且我常常为此很恼火。
zh_hant: 而且我常常為此很惱火。

text: And then as you get older and wiser,
zh: 然后随着你长大变得更聪明，
zh_hant: 然後隨著你長大變得更聰明，

text: you realise actually it looks fine.
zh: 你意识到其实它看起来挺好的。
zh_hant: 你意識到其實它看起來挺好的。

text: And I quite...
I quite like it.
I don't get my hair cut that often,
so it often gets a bit too long and messy for me.
zh: 所以通常它会变得有点太长太乱。
zh_hant: 所以通常它會變得有點太長太亂。

text: And then when I can't put up with it any longer, I go and get it cut.
zh: 然后当再也受不了时，我就去剪了。
zh_hant: 然後當再也受不了時，我就去剪了。

text: And how do you feel about the hairdresser?
zh: 那你对去理发店感觉怎么样？
zh_hant: 那你對去理髮店感覺怎麼樣？

text: Do you like the experience?
I don't mind it.
It's not...
it's not something I really like doing but I don't really mind it.
zh: 那不是我真的喜欢做的事，但我也真的不介意。
zh_hant: 那不是我真的喜歡做的事，但我也真的不介意。

text: I don't have a problem with it and it does feel good to come out and it's a lot neater than it was when you went in.
zh: 我对此没有意见，而且出来后的感觉确实很好，比进去时整洁多了。
zh_hant: 我對此沒有意見，而且出來後的感覺確實很好，比進去時整潔多了。

text: Yeah.
How long does a usual appointment take when you go to the hairdresser?
zh: 你去理发店通常一次要花多久？
zh_hant: 你去理髮店通常一次要花多久？

text: It depends how busy it is,
but if it's quiet,
I can probably go in 20–30 minutes and it's done.
zh: 我大概20到30分钟就能弄完。
zh_hant: 我大概20到30分鐘就能弄完。

text: Wow.
What about you?
Well, I think my experience of the hairdresser is a little bit different.
zh: 嗯，我觉得我去理发店的体验有点不同。
zh_hant: 嗯，我覺得我去理髮店的體驗有點不同。

text: If I get a haircut and a hair dye – so, a hair dye is when you change the colour –
zh: 如果我去剪头发并染发——染发就是改变头发颜色——
zh_hant: 如果我去剪頭髮並染髮——染髮就是改變頭髮顏色——

text: it can take about three hours.
zh: 可能需要大约三个小时。
zh_hant: 可能需要大約三個小時。

text: But I actually enjoy it.
I probably go to the hairdresser once every six months,
zh: 我可能每六个月去一次理发店，
zh_hant: 我可能每六個月去一次理髮店，

text: and when I go, it's like a treat.
zh: 去的时候就像犒劳自己一样。
zh_hant: 去的時候就像犒勞自己一樣。

text: OK.
You told us about the hairdresser's, Georgie.
zh: 你跟我们说了理发店的事，乔治。
zh_hant: 你跟我們說了理髮店的事，喬治。

text: Do you often change your hairstyle?
Well, when I was at university,
I once dyed my hair – not all of it,
zh: 我有一次染了头发——不是全部，
zh_hant: 我有一次染了頭髮——不是全部，

text: but half of it pink and green.
But the dye , the hair dye , wasn't permanent.
zh: 但那个染料，那个染发剂，不是持久的。
zh_hant: 但那個染料，那個染髮劑，不是持久的。

text: It was temporary, so the colour didn't stay,
zh: 是暂时的，所以颜色没有留下来，
zh_hant: 是暫時的，所以顏色沒有留下來，

text: which was probably good for me.
I don't think I suited it.
But recently I actually have thought about growing my hair,
zh: 但最近我真的想过留长头发，
zh_hant: 但最近我真的想過留長頭髮，

text: so I want to grow it,
make it a bit longer and I want to stop dyeing it as well.
zh: 变长一点，而且我也不想再染了。
zh_hant: 變長一點，而且我也不想再染了。

text: So, in the last few years I have been dyeing my hair a bit blonder ,
zh: 所以，在过去的几年里，我把头发染得更金了一点，
zh_hant: 所以，在過去的幾年裡，我把頭髮染得更金了一點，

text: but I was looking at some old photos of me when I had brown,
zh: 但我看了些以前棕色头发的老照片，
zh_hant: 但我看了些以前棕色頭髮的老照片，

text: natural hair, and I think I'd like to go back to it.
zh: 我想我希望能回到那样。
zh_hant: 我想我希望能回到那樣。

text: Yeah.
What about you?
I don't think I'm going to change my hair.
Do you think green would suit?
Phil, I think you would look great with green hair.
zh: 菲尔，我觉得你染绿头发会很好看。
zh_hant: 菲爾，我覺得你染綠頭髮會很好看。

text: Maybe.
we should try that, because my hair is changing its colour itself.
zh: 我们应该试试，因为我的头发正在自己变色。
zh_hant: 我們應該試試，因為我的頭髮正在自己變色。

text: It's going greyer and greyer and greyer.
zh: 它越来越灰、越来越灰、越来越灰。
zh_hant: 它越來越灰、越來越灰、越來越灰。

text: And every time I get my hair cut, more grey comes off.
zh: 而且每次我剪头发，更多灰色就掉了。
zh_hant: 而且每次我剪頭髮，更多灰色就掉了。

text: Ah, well, maybe green would be...
...the way forward!
Yeah.
The other thing is there's less of it.
When I get my hair cut, I can see it's higher up,
zh: 我剪头发时，能看到发际线更高了，
zh_hant: 我剪頭髮時，能看到髮際線更高了，

text: and there's a bit going a little bit bald there,
zh: 而且那里有一点开始秃了，
zh_hant: 而且那裡有一點開始禿了，

text: but hopefully no one notices.
Let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
zh: 让我们回顾一下对话中听到的语言。
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下對話中聽到的語言。

text: If you dye your hair,
and that's spelt 'D-Y-E',
then you use chemicals to change the colour.
zh: 那就是用化学品改变颜色。
zh_hant: 那就是用化學品改變顏色。

text: hair is a light colour, a bit like yellow.
zh: 头发是浅色的，有点像黄色。
zh_hant: 頭髮是淺色的，有點像黃色。

text: hair is a bit like orange.
If your hair is curly or wavy , it's not straight.
zh: 如果你的头发是卷的或波浪的，就不是直的。
zh_hant: 如果你的頭髮是卷的或波浪的，就不是直的。

text: It has curves.
And if you're bald , you don't have any hair on your head.
zh: 如果你是秃的，你头上就没有头发。
zh_hant: 如果你是禿的，你頭上就沒有頭髮。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 本期《简单英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《簡單英語》就到這裡。

text: We'll be back next week with another conversation in easy English.
zh: 下周我们会带来另一个简单英语对话。
zh_hant: 下週我們會帶來另一個簡單英語對話。

text: And don't forget to test what you've learned with the free worksheet on our website.
zh: 别忘了用我们网站上的免费练习表测试你学到的东西。
zh_hant: 別忘了用我們網站上的免費練習表測試你學到的東西。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Bye for now.
Goodbye!
